headline: Launch: 27 offers, UK deadlines this week
highlights: EY-Parthenon London strategy graduate scheme closes on 22 Oct, L.E.K. London on 25 Oct, OC&C on 1 Nov.
Best corporate-strategy fits right now: Saft (TotalEnergies) Strategy Analyst and Danone EU Strategy, both 6-month internships from January 2027.
Roland Berger Paris asks for 6 months of experience: your Singapore internship covers it.
UK roles need the right to work in the UK: Accenture says it cannot sponsor a visa for its Strategy programme.

headline: 50 new offers; Kearney London closes tomorrow
highlights: 50 offers added this week (27 corporate strategy, 23 consulting), 42 in Paris, across fintech, banking, private equity, construction, food, spirits, software, hospitality, mobility and insurance.
Best fits for you: Bouygues Construction Corporate Strategy Intern (low-carbon and waste-diversion agenda), Edenred Group Strategy Intern, and Ardian Corporate Development intern (March 2027).
Deadlines: Kearney London Business Analyst closes 27 Oct, OC&C London Associate 1 Nov; L.E.K. London closed on 25 Oct and EY-Parthenon UK may have closed on 22 Oct.

New in the calendar: BCG Singapore Associate Internship 2027, Singapore EDB Associate Programme, Enterprise Singapore MAP and Société Générale General Inspection 2027; Oliver Wyman reported Q3 consulting revenue up 14%.
Tip: Bain Paris took intern applications 1 Jan-28 Feb last cycle, so polish your case-interview prep and CV in November to be ready when the window opens.
